description: Find USDA Market News reports, then retrieve an explicit report/date range. Catalog search is local filtering of official report titles; it does not guarantee a daily report for every commodity. Report dates, grades, weight/package and price-unit fields remain source data, not a guaranteed sale price. At most seven days per report query within the last35days, maximum50 returned rows. No automatic mixed-grade average, midpoint or package conversion. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive words matched in report title/slug.

dateField.description: Optional official date field, default report_date.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD; no future dates; at most7days after from.

name: buscalc_usda_market_data_lookup
title: USDA agricultural market report lookup
